title: Looking for character artists for published and upcoming books

title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body characters under £300

author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author seeking character artists for dark fantasy book illustrations
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT. Contact by linking portfolio in the replies.

author: Carolina
title: Looking for 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator! I’m looking for a creative talent who can: Create flat character illustrations (2D). Design and develop 3D characters. Animate characters in both 2D and 3D. Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus. If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com. No AI.

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokémon scenes on card binders
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. This is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. Contact by sending portfolios, pricing, and availability via replies.
